rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Quiet lane's grassy west edge near the bottom; homes 11-15 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 11-15 m away on own side
Residents' cars park along the lane
Narrow lane, tight to pull clear

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 12, 11 and 15 m (at 43, 53, 63 m) on the west side; higher up they are 7-9 m, so this lower section is the only one over 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow lane; a grass strip beside the west kerb gives some room but it is vegetated and tight.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the lane, but they look like residents' cars; no other overnight use.

flags: Steep: about 5% over the best section, mean 6.5% overall
Homes within about 25 m all round
Houses 7-9 m away on the upper half of the kerb
sun_shade: Trees along the west side shade mornings; houses to the east shade late afternoon.
cannot_judge: whether the west strip is a legal parking edge

best_section.where: Lower end of Tyne Street, west kerb beside the grass strip, just above the cross street
